name: JUNREN
source:
Main character realizes his feelings for childhood friend Yuka, so he enrolls into her school in Tokyo. But Yuka grows very beautiful, and there are serious sempai around her, so protagonist remains just a childhood friend and puts up with the idea that she supposedly already has a boyfriend. Unaware of Yuka feelings, boy confesses to a girl from part-time job, but girl soon realizes that even during dates his heart is elsewhere.
These relations get intricately entangled and gradually change their form...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公察觉到自己对青梅竹马由香的感情，于是进入她在东京就读的学校。然而，由香已经出落得十分美丽，身边还有几位认真的学长，主人公始终只是她的青梅竹马，并接受了她大概已有男朋友的想法。少年没有察觉由香的心意，转而向兼职时认识的女孩告白；对方却很快发现，即使约会时，他的心也依然留在别处。
这些关系错综复杂地纠缠在一起，并逐渐改变形态…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
